notes: Expect.toSatisfy waits until a page function returns true on the locator's one match, called in the isolated world as locator.evaluate is and checked again after each page change. It takes a function, never source text; only true passes, not any truthy value; a throw fails it at once rather than being retried; and it returns nothing, so read a value afterwards with locator.evaluate. Stock WebKit refuses it as Unsupported.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: A predicate that runs in the page is one named expectation, `Expect.toSatisfy`, over a locator's one match.
